title: Implementing (part of) a BitTorrent client in Rust
summary: Jon Gjengset's roughly four-hour live stream implementing part of a BitTorrent client in Rust, following CodeCrafters' test-guided challenge. He builds from scratch and shows idiomatic error handling along the way.
why: HN recommends it as a comprehensive walkthrough of the build-your-own-BitTorrent challenge and as an introduction to CodeCrafters.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Jon Gjengset did a comprehensive stream going through the Build your own BitTorrent challenge
